> **Do not disclose an exploitable vulnerability in a public issue.** Use the repository's private security advisory flow or contact the maintainer privately first.
>
> **不要在公开 Issue 中披露可利用的漏洞。** 请先使用仓库的私密安全公告流程或私下联系维护者。

## Private report confirmation / 私密报告确认

- [ ] I have not included secrets, working exploits, personal data, or production access details.
- [ ] 我没有包含密钥、可直接利用的完整代码、个人数据或生产环境访问细节。
- [ ] I understand this public template is only for coordinating a private report.
- [ ] 我理解此公开模板仅用于协调私密报告。

## Affected component / 受影响组件

- Version / 版本:
- DSH version / DSH 版本:
- Deployment / 部署方式:
- Component or endpoint / 组件或端点:

## Impact / 影响

<!-- Explain confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, or authorization impact without publishing a weaponized exploit. -->
<!-- 说明对机密性、完整性、可用性、认证或授权的影响，但不要公开可直接利用的攻击细节。 -->

## Safe reproduction summary / 安全复现摘要

<!-- Provide only the minimum information needed to establish the issue. Send sensitive details privately. -->
<!-- 只提供确认问题所需的最小信息，敏感细节私下发送。 -->
